shortDescription: Run commands in a VMware guest operating system

options.name: cluster
options.description: The cluster hosting the virtual machine. If set, it will help to speed up virtual machine search.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter hosting the virtual machine. If set, it will help to speed up virtual machine search.

options.name: folder
options.description: Destination folder, absolute or relative path to find an existing guest or create the new guest. The folder should include the datacenter. ESX's datacenter is ha-datacenter. Examples:    folder: /ha-datacenter/vm    folder: ha-datacenter/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm    folder: datacenter1/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm/folder2 Required if O(vm_id_type=

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds. If set to positive integers, then O(wait_for_process=true) will honor this parameter and will exit after this timeout.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vm_id
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to work with.

options.name: vm_id_type
options.description: The VMware identification method by which the virtual machine will be identified.

options.name: vm_password
options.description: The password used to login-in to the virtual machine.

options.name: vm_shell
options.description: The absolute path to the program to start. On Linux, shell is executed via bash.

options.name: vm_shell_args
options.description: The argument to the program. The characters which must be escaped to the shell also be escaped on the command line provided.

options.name: vm_shell_cwd
options.description: The current working directory of the application from which it will be run.

options.name: vm_shell_env
options.description: Comma separated list of environment variable, specified in the guest OS notation.

options.name: vm_username
options.description: The user to login-in to the virtual machine.

options.name: wait_for_process
options.description: If set to V(true), module will wait for process to complete in the given virtual machine.
